bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/gaybbs-gate-link-20261115"
compose="$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$compose" || exit 67
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin chat/menu-link-creator-runtime-hotfix-20261115
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = ab7f2b0c3ee458e21110fb44f6767294e0a0d62b || exit 74
if test -d "$work"; then
 test -z "$(git -C "$work" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76
 git -C "$work" checkout --detach ab7f2b0c3ee458e21110fb44f6767294e0a0d62b
else
 git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$work" ab7f2b0c3ee458e21110fb44f6767294e0a0d62b
fi
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = ab7f2b0c3ee458e21110fb44f6767294e0a0d62b || exit 74
log="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$work/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-ab7f2b0 "$work" >"$log" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$log";then exit 51;fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$log";then exit 52;fi
 if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|TLS handshake' "$log";then exit 53;fi
 exit 55
fi
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-ab7f2b0)"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-ab7f2b0 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 81
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image tag "$before" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-gate-link-20261115
cat > "$work/live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-ab7f2b0
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$work/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-gate-link-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/live.yaml" config --quiet || exit 69
changed=0
recover(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;if test "$changed" = 1;then docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=PASS || echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=FAIL;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap recover ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || false
trap - ERR
echo GAYBBS_GATE_LINK_DEPLOY=PASS
echo TARGET_SHA=ab7f2b0c3ee458e21110fb44f6767294e0a0d62b
echo IMAGE_ID="$newid"
echo USERBOT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
